_doc: Outcome cases for run_outcome.py. kind 'flow': a merged fix replayed from the commit before it; the right outcome is a new validating flow. kind 'fallback': a bug with no on-screen symptom a flow can assert; the right outcome is 'no validating flow' plus a test. fix: the fix's commit on master (the base is its parent). remove: files deleted from the base because they give the answer away. scrub: files whose lines naming those files are dropped.
